Do you doubt that Yomin Carr has performed?''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''No, Prefect. ''Belek tiu''.|Da'Gara and Tu Shoolb|translated=1|<ref name="NJO" />}}
The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Tu Shoolb''' served the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]] as an intendant of the [[Domain Shoolb]]. He assisted [[Prefect (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Prefect]] [[Da'Gara]] aboard the latter's [[Da'Gara's worldship|worldship]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|Yuuzhan Vong invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Koros-Strohna|worldship's]] voyage to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Helska IV]], he suggested not to accelerate in speed to Da'Gara, as an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]&mdash;which Gara's worldship was posing as&mdash;would not accelerate so &quot;obviously.&quot; However, his prefect refused to comply in anticipation for his arrival.

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]], Tu Shoolb was a member of his [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|empire]] and its [[Domain Shoolb]] family, who assisted the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|Vong invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|under]] [[Prefect (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Prefect]] [[Da'Gara]] aboard the prefect's [[Da'Gara's worldship|worldship]].<ref name="NJO" /> In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="EAC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Gara ordered Shoolb to accelerate the [[Koros-Strohna|worldship]], and the latter alerted the prefect that changing the worldship's speed could alert observers&mdash;[[ExGal-4|members]] of the [[Extragalactic Society]] organization focused on searching for extra&ndash;galactic life&mdash;as natural bodies would not accelerate so obviously, which would prompt them to study the ship.<ref name="NJO" />

The prefect inquired his underling if he thought that the Vong agent [[Yomin Carr]] had not [[Death/Legends|killed]] them as he had been commanded to do, prompting an apology from Shoolb using the [[Yuuzhan Vong (language)|''Belek tiu'']] Yuuzhan Vong phrase. The Domain Shoolb member then accelerated the worldship with its [[dovin basal]]s, which propelled it, under Gara's directive. Although he reconsidered his order, Gara did not belay it, as he was anxious to arrive at their destination, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Helska IV]].<ref name="NJO" />

==Personality and traits==
Tu Shoolb was considered cunning and resourceful by Prefect Gara.<ref name="NJO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tu Shoolb appeared in the [[1999]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]'', written by [[R. A. Salvatore]], the first volume in the ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]'' novel series.<ref name="NJO" />
